commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Kyle Walker (Burnley) argues with the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
90+3' Kyle Walker (Burnley) makes a slide tackle, but referee Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
90+3' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Bart Verbruggen to dive and make a save.
90+2' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
90+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Brighton players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' Florentino (Burnley) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
87' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Brajan Gruda is replaced by Tom Watson (Brighton).
85' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 5:15.
83' What a strike! Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) hits the left post from the free kick.
83' Brighton win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
83' Josh Laurent (Burnley) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tim Robinson stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
81' Here is a change. Jaidon Anthony is going off and Scott Parker gives the last tactical orders to Jaydon Banel (Burnley).
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. James Milner (Brighton) for Diego Gomez.
79' That's unlucky! Pascal Gross (Brighton) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

67' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) was close to scoring a goal as he sent a header from inside the six-yard box towards the target. The ball hits one of the defenders standing on the goal line and bounces off him onto the post.
67' A corner kick by Burnley is thwarted by the well prepared Bart Verbruggen (Brighton).
66' Oliver Sonne (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
64' It is time for a substitution. Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) is on for Armando Broja.

55' Scott Parker has decided to make a change. Marcus Edwards (Burnley) replaces Jacob Bruun Larsen.
55' Today's match ends for Lesley Ugochukwu who will be replaced by Oliver Sonne (Burnley).
53' The current number of corner kicks is 3:3.

50' Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
47' 2 - 0 Yasin Ayari (Brighton) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Tim Robinson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+1' Florentino (Burnley) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

43' 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.

39' Florentino (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tim Robinson ignores the protests.
37' Burnley fail to score from a corner as Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) leaps to collect the ball.
36' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
34' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post!
33' Tim Robinson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kyle Walker (Burnley).
31' Florentino (Burnley) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

26' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
25' A cross into the box from Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is cleared.
24' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Josh Laurent (Burnley) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' A pass from Armando Broja (Burnley) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
21' Diego Gomez (Brighton) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
20' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar.
19' Lucas Pires (Burnley) trips an opposition player and Tim Robinson signals a foul.
18' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
18' Diego Gomez (Brighton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
14' Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
7' Joel Veltman (Brighton) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
7' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
6' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
3' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tim Robinson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
